scope: Local v1 implementation and verification audit; not a release-readiness or full Obsidian parity claim.

implementation: Per-row 24 px gutters, centered 760 px maximum column, consistent typography and surface in Reading and Split
limits: Native screenshots cover representative fixtures, not every theme or DPI.

implementation: Source-preserving wiki, Markdown, reference-definition and attachment destinations
Folder and attachment explorer rename/move actions
No-overwrite moves, collision preflight and rollback
limits: Backlinks remain wiki based. Ambiguous bare names require an explicit path.

implementation: Shared CommonMark inline parsing and source mapping
Whole-document lists, nested quotes, aligned tables, references, code and standard task controls
Colored highlights
Native nested and foldable Reading callouts
Custom Unicode task markers with undoable Reading and keyboard toggles
Named and inline Reading footnotes with document numbering, formatted footer definitions, and forward/return navigation
Background syntax coloring in Reading, Source and Live Preview, with staged full layout and a bounded decoration cache
limits: See all missing/partial families in the coverage inventory. In particular superscript/Live Preview footnotes, exhaustive syntax-language coverage, math, Mermaid, HTML, transclusion and media are incomplete or absent.
Live Preview block widgets are not equivalent to Reading.
Supported means implemented, not exhaustively parity verified.

implementation: Durable snapshots of prior saved contents
Version comparison and undoable restore command
Per-note retention, hash validation and symlink rejection
limits: History keys follow paths; older versions remain under the previous path after rename.

implementation: Durable before-text/after-hash journal before writes
Restart-safe undo with whole-batch conflict preflight
Refuses to overwrite external changes
limits: Batch journals are not automatically pruned.

implementation: Portable release profile
Linux/Windows/macOS package script and CI matrix
Platform-specific no-overwrite rename
limits: No configured Git remote or native Windows/macOS runner is available here.
Windows rename module cross-check passed; full GNU cross-build stops at missing MinGW C compiler.
Packages are unsigned; native install, signing/notarization and broad Linux distribution checks remain.

requirements.status: simulated checks pass; real composition pending
limits: IME tests exercise the UTF-16/composition bridge, not a real composing engine. Local Fcitx is configured only with a keyboard layout.

requirements.requirement: Clipboard, external changes and crash recovery
evidence: Native isolated-vault clipboard/drop, external-conflict, clean-refresh and restart checks
Editor and workspace keyboard interaction tests
Source inspection of native editor and UI controls
limits: Screen-reader semantics are not explicitly exposed or verified. Keyboard coverage does not establish accessibility conformance.

real_vault_audit.checks: Source bounds and UTF-8, nonoverlapping source rows, display spans, folded/footer projection round trips, and footnote return positions, syntax-color source spans
